cn-20260923-intro-retail-5.title: [Retail Studies #5] Selling the Same Bottle of Water at Three Prices: A Store's "Format" Is Actually a List of Trade-offs

segments.src: > 百货店、大卖场、便利店、专业店的区别,不在于卖什么,而在于它们在"选择、价格、便利"这三件事上,替你做了不同的取舍。
segments.tr: > The difference between department stores, hypermarkets, convenience stores, and specialty stores is not what they sell, but the different trade-offs they make for you regarding "selection, price, and convenience".

segments.src: 先分清两个容易混的词。
segments.tr: First, let's distinguish between two easily confused terms.

segments.src: **业种**回答的是"卖什么"——书店、鞋店、水果店,这是按商品品类分的。
segments.tr: **Line of business (业种)** answers "what is sold"—bookstores, shoe stores, fruit stores. This is classified by product category.

segments.src: **业态**回答的是"怎么卖"——同样卖一瓶水、一包纸巾,可以开成便利店、大卖场,也可以摆进百货公司的地下超市。业态是一整套经营方式的组合。
segments.tr: **Retail format (业态)** answers "how it is sold"—selling the same bottle of water or pack of tissues can be done by opening a convenience store, a hypermarket, or placing them in the basement supermarket of a department store. A retail format is a combination of a complete set of operating methods.

segments.src: 这套组合大致由四个变量决定:
segments.tr: This combination is roughly determined by four variables:

segments.src: 1. **商品的广度与深度**:品类跨得有多宽?每个品类里可选的有多少?
segments.tr: 1. **Breadth and depth of products**: How wide is the category span? How many choices are available within each category?

segments.src: 2. **价格与毛利**:走薄利多销,还是靠高毛利养高成本?
segments.tr: 2. **Price and gross margin**: Do you go for high volume with low margins, or rely on high gross margins to support high costs?

segments.src: 3. **面积与选址**:开在社区楼下、地铁口,还是城郊大马路边?
segments.tr: 3. **Area and location**: Is it opened downstairs in a residential community, at a subway entrance, or by a big road in the suburbs?

segments.src: 4. **服务与营业时间**:自助为主,还是有导购、有试穿、有配送?
segments.tr: 4. **Service and business hours**: Is it mainly self-service, or are there shopping assistants, fitting rooms, and delivery services?

segments.src: 我国的国家标准《零售业态分类》(GB/T 18106)也是按类似维度——选址、规模、商品结构、价格、服务功能——把零售门店划成一系列业态的。
segments.tr: Our national standard "Classification of Retail Formats" (GB/T 18106) also classifies retail stores into a series of formats based on similar dimensions—location, scale, product structure, price, and service functions.

segments.src: 四种最典型的形态,可以这样对照看:
segments.tr: The four most typical forms can be compared as follows:

segments.src: | | 百货店 | 大卖场 | 便利店 | 专业店 |
segments.tr: | | Department Store | Hypermarket | Convenience Store | Specialty Store |
| Typical Area | Over 10,000 sqm | 5000~20000 sqm | 60~150 sqm | Hundreds to thousands of sqm |

segments.src: | 商品结构 | 服饰美妆为主,**宽而浅** | 吃穿用全覆盖,**又宽又浅** | 即食+应急,**窄而浅** | 单一品类做透,**窄而深** |
segments.tr: | Product Structure | Mainly apparel and cosmetics, **wide and shallow** | Covers food, clothing, and daily use, **wide and shallow** | Ready-to-eat + emergency, **narrow and shallow** | Single category done thoroughly, **narrow and deep** |

segments.src: | 核心卖点 | 品牌、体验、逛 | 一站买齐、便宜 | 近、快、随时 | 专业、齐全、懂行 |
segments.tr: | Core Selling Point | Brand, experience, browsing | One-stop shopping, cheap | Close, fast, anytime | Professional, complete, knowledgeable |

segments.src: | 盈利逻辑 | 多为联营扣点,按品牌销售额抽成 | 低毛利、高周转、大规模采购议价 | 高毛利(鲜食尤其)、高频次 | 品类专业度换溢价与复购 |
segments.tr: | Profit Logic | Mostly joint-venture commissions, drawing percentages based on brand sales | Low margin, high turnover, large-scale procurement bargaining | High margin (especially fresh food), high frequency | Category professionalism exchanged for premium and repurchase |

segments.src: | 例子 | 银泰、王府井 | 大润发、永辉 | 罗森、美宜佳 | 孩子王、屈臣氏 |
segments.tr: | Examples | InTime, Wangfujing | RT-Mart, Yonghui | Lawson, Meiyijia | Kidswant, Watsons |

segments.src: 顺带一提,**专业店**和**专卖店**不是一回事:孩子王卖各家品牌的母婴用品,是专业店;小米之家只卖自家品牌,是专卖店。
segments.tr: By the way, **specialty stores (专业店)** and **exclusive shops (专卖店)** are not the same thing: Kidswant sells maternal and child products from various brands, which is a specialty store; Xiaomi Home only sells its own brand, which is an exclusive shop.

segments.src: 背后其实是一个很朴素的算式:
segments.tr: Behind this is actually a very simple formula:

segments.src: 利润 ≈ 毛利率 × 周转次数
segments.tr: 利润 ≈ 毛利率 × 周转次数

segments.src: 大卖场压毛利、催周转;便利店周转体量小,只能靠毛利和便利溢价补回来。没有哪家店能同时做到最便宜、最齐全、最方便——**业态,就是这道三选二难题的稳定解**。
segments.tr: Hypermarkets compress gross margins and drive turnover; convenience stores have a small turnover volume and can only make up for it through gross margins and convenience premiums. No store can be the cheapest, most complete, and most convenient all at once—**retail format is the stable solution to this "choose two out of three" dilemma**.

segments.src: 设想你在上海过一个周六。
segments.tr: Imagine spending a Saturday in Shanghai.

segments.src: 早上七点半,赶地铁前拐进楼下便利店,一个饭团加一杯咖啡,**十几块**。同样一瓶500ml的矿泉水,这里卖**3元**,超市货架上**2元**,网上整箱买下来一瓶**1块出头**。多付的那一块多,买的不是水,是"下楼三十秒就能拿到"。
segments.tr: At 7:30 in the morning, before rushing to the subway, you drop by the convenience store downstairs for a rice ball and a cup of coffee, costing **a dozen yuan**. The same 500ml bottle of mineral water costs **3 yuan** here, **2 yuan** on a supermarket shelf, and **a little over 1 yuan** per bottle if bought in boxes online. That extra yuan or so you pay is not for the water, but for "being able to get it thirty seconds downstairs".

segments.src: 中午开车去郊区的大卖场囤货:米、油、纸巾、洗衣液,推车装满,**四五百块**。单价明显便宜,代价是来回两小时车程和一次性的大额支出。
segments.tr: At noon, you drive to a suburban hypermarket to stock up: rice, oil, tissues, laundry detergent, filling up a cart for **four to five hundred yuan**. The unit price is noticeably cheaper, but the cost is a two-hour round-trip drive and a one-time large expenditure.

segments.src: 下午逛南京西路的百货公司,试衣服、试香水、喝杯咖啡。这里的东西未必最便宜,但**能上身、能闻到、能被导购说服**——你付的是体验和即时确认。
segments.tr: In the afternoon, you visit a department store on West Nanjing Road to try on clothes, sample perfume, and drink a cup of coffee. The things here may not be the cheapest, but **you can wear them, smell them, and be persuaded by a shopping assistant**—you are paying for the experience and instant confirmation.

segments.src: 晚上娃的奶粉快见底,直奔母婴专业店。整面墙全是奶粉,分月龄、分配方,店员能讲清区别。**别的地方也卖奶粉,但没人能给你讲这么细**。
segments.tr: At night, your child's milk powder is running low, so you head straight to a maternal and child specialty store. The whole wall is full of milk powder, divided by month and formula, and the clerk can explain the differences. **Other places also sell milk powder, but no one can explain it to you in such detail**.

segments.src: 一天四家店,你没有"背叛"谁——你只是在不同场景下,对选择、价格、便利做了四次不同的排序。零售商要做的,就是提前猜中其中一种排序,并把整家店围绕它搭起来。
segments.tr: Four stores in one day, and you haven't "betrayed" any of them—you are simply making four different sortings of selection, price, and convenience in different scenarios. What retailers need to do is to guess one of these sortings in advance and build the entire store around it.

segments.src: 1. 业种是"卖什么",业态是"怎么卖";同样的商品可以装进完全不同的门店里。
segments.tr: 1. Line of business is "what is sold", retail format is "how it is sold"; the same goods can be packed into completely different stores.

segments.src: 2. 业态由商品广度与深度、价格与毛利、面积与选址、服务与时间这几个变量共同决定。
segments.tr: 2. Retail format is jointly determined by variables such as product breadth and depth, price and gross margin, area and location, service and time.

segments.src: 3. 便宜、齐全、方便三者难以兼得,每一种业态都是一次公开的取舍——顾客也在按场景切换选择。
segments.tr: 3. Cheap, complete, and convenient are hard to all have at once, and every retail format is an open trade-off—customers also switch choices according to scenarios.

segments.src: (O/X)** "业种"回答的是卖什么,"业态"回答的是怎么卖。
segments.tr: (O/X)** "Line of business" answers what is sold, and "retail format" answers how it is sold.

segments.src: **2.** 楼下便利店的矿泉水比超市贵一块钱,最主要的原因是:
segments.tr: **2.** The main reason why mineral water at the downstairs convenience store is one yuan more expensive than at the supermarket is:

segments.src: 便利店的进货价一定更高
segments.tr: The procurement price of convenience stores must be higher

segments.src: 顾客购买的是即时性和距离,而高租金、小体量需要更高毛利支撑
segments.tr: Customers are buying immediacy and distance, while high rent and small volume require higher gross margins to support

segments.src: 便利店卖的是不同品牌
售价由主管部门统一规定
segments.tr: Selling prices are uniformly set by competent authorities

segments.src: **3.** 下列哪一家最接近"专业店"的定义?
segments.tr: **3.** Which of the following is closest to the definition of a "specialty store"?

segments.src: - **业态**:按经营方式(商品结构、价格、面积、选址、服务等)划分的零售门店类型。
segments.tr: - **Retail format (业态)**: Types of retail stores classified by operating methods (product structure, price, area, location, service, etc.).

segments.src: - **业种**:按所经营商品的品类划分的行业类别,如服装业、食品业。
segments.tr: - **Line of business (业种)**: Industry categories classified by the category of goods operated, such as the apparel industry, food industry.

segments.src: - **SKU**:最小存货单位,粗略可理解为"一款单品";便利店通常两三千个,大卖场可达数万。
segments.tr: - **SKU**: Stock Keeping Unit, roughly understood as "a single item"; convenience stores usually have two to three thousand, and hypermarkets can reach tens of thousands.

segments.src: - **坪效**:每平方米营业面积在一定时期内创造的销售额,衡量小店效率的关键指标。
segments.tr: - **Sales per square meter (坪效)**: The sales generated by each square meter of business area in a certain period, a key indicator for measuring small store efficiency.

segments.src: - **联营扣点**:百货店常见模式,品牌方进场自行经营,百货按其销售额抽取约定比例作为收入。
segments.tr: - **Joint-venture commission (联营扣点)**: A common model in department stores where brands enter and operate by themselves, and the department store extracts an agreed proportion of their sales as income.

segments.src: - **专业店 / 专卖店**:前者聚焦单一品类、经营多个品牌;后者只经营某一个品牌的商品。
segments.tr: - **Specialty store / Exclusive shop**: The former focuses on a single category and operates multiple brands; the latter only operates goods of a single brand.

segments.src: O ——同一件商品(业种不变)可以在便利店、超市、百货里以完全不同的方式售卖(业态不同)。
segments.tr: O ——The same item (line of business unchanged) can be sold in completely different ways in convenience stores, supermarkets, and department stores (different retail formats).

segments.src: B ——便利店的进货成本未必更高,溢价来自便利性,同时高租金、单店销量有限也要求更高毛利率。
segments.tr: B ——The procurement cost of convenience stores is not necessarily higher, the premium comes from convenience, and at the same time high rent and limited single-store sales also require higher gross profit margins.

segments.src: B ——孩子王聚焦母婴单一品类、汇集多个品牌,是典型专业店;大润发是大卖场,罗森是便利店,银泰是百货店。*
segments.tr: B ——Kidswant focuses on the single category of maternal and child products, gathering multiple brands, and is a typical specialty store; RT-Mart is a hypermarket, Lawson is a convenience store, and Intime is a department store.*

cn-20260923-news-1.title: Xi Jinping Departs for US Visit: Rare Welcome at Andrews Air Force Base, White House Talks on the 24th Focus on Trade and Regional Issues

segments.src: 据多家媒体报道，中国国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问。这是近年来中美两国最高层级互动中备受瞩目的一站，行程虽仅三天,但涉及的议题几乎涵盖了当前中美关系中最核心的几个方面——从经贸摩擦到地区安全，再到前沿科技领域的竞合。
segments.tr: According to multiple media reports, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25. This is a highly anticipated stop in the highest-level interactions between China and the US in recent years. Although the trip lasts only three days, the topics involved cover almost all the most core aspects of current China-US relations—from trade friction to regional security, and competition and cooperation in frontier technology fields.

segments.src: 外界普遍认为，此访是双方在经历一段时间的紧张与磋商后，试图为两国关系寻求相对稳定框架的重要契机。
segments.tr: It is widely believed by the outside world that this visit is an important opportunity for both sides to seek a relatively stable framework for bilateral relations after a period of tension and consultation.

segments.src: ## 安德鲁斯基地的迎接礼遇
segments.tr: ## Welcome Courtesy at Andrews Air Force Base

segments.src: 多家媒体注意到，美方在礼宾安排上展现出较高规格。据报道，美国总统特朗普罕见地亲自前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接到访的中国代表团，这一安排在以往的外国元首访问中并不多见，因此也被外交观察人士视为释放某种积极信号的举动。
segments.tr: Many media outlets have noted that the US side has shown a high level of protocol. According to reports, US President Trump rarely went to Joint Base Andrews in person to welcome the visiting Chinese delegation. This arrangement is uncommon in previous visits by foreign heads of state, and is therefore seen by diplomatic observers as a move to send a positive signal.

segments.src: 分析人士指出，礼宾细节往往能折射出双方当下的外交考量，但具体意涵仍需结合后续会谈的实际成果来判断，不宜过度解读。
segments.tr: Analysts point out that protocol details often reflect the current diplomatic considerations of both sides, but the specific implications still need to be judged in conjunction with the actual results of subsequent talks, and should not be over-interpreted.
## White House Talks and State Dinner Arrangements on the 24th

segments.src: 根据目前已披露的日程，双方定于9月24日在白宫举行正式会谈，随后设国宴款待来访代表团。这也是本次访问中最核心的环节。
segments.tr: According to the currently disclosed schedule, the two sides are scheduled to hold formal talks at the White House on September 24, followed by a state dinner to host the visiting delegation. This is also the core part of this visit.

segments.src: 据了解，会谈议题预计将覆盖以下几个方面：
segments.tr: It is understood that the topics of the talks are expected to cover the following aspects:

segments.src: - **关税与贸易摩擦**：双方近年来在部分商品关税上存在分歧，此次会谈可能就阶段性调整或磋商机制进行讨论。
segments.tr: - **Tariffs and Trade Friction**: The two sides have had differences on tariffs for some goods in recent years, and this meeting may discuss phased adjustments or consultation mechanisms.

segments.src: - **稀土等关键资源供应**：稀土及相关关键矿产的贸易与出口政策，是近期两国经贸对话中反复被提及的议题之一。
segments.tr: - **Supply of Key Resources such as Rare Earths**: Trade and export policies for rare earths and related critical minerals are one of the topics that have been repeatedly mentioned in recent economic and trade dialogues between the two countries.

segments.src: - **地区安全相关议题**：包括外界关注的对台军事相关政策动向，双方可能就各自立场进行沟通,以避免误判。
segments.tr: - **Regional Security-Related Issues**: Including the military-related policy trends regarding Taiwan that the outside world is concerned about, the two sides may communicate their respective positions to avoid misjudgment.

segments.src: - **人工智能技术限制**：随着人工智能产业的快速发展，双方在先进芯片、算法及相关技术出口管制方面的分歧也被认为是本次磋商的重点之一。
segments.tr: - **Artificial Intelligence Technology Restrictions**: With the rapid development of the artificial intelligence industry, the differences between the two sides in export controls on advanced chips, algorithms, and related technologies are also considered one of the focuses of this consultation.

segments.src: 需要说明的是,上述议题多具有高度敏感性和不确定性，实际会谈内容与结果以双方官方公布的信息为准，媒体报道中的预测性内容仅供参考。
segments.tr: It should be noted that the above topics are highly sensitive and uncertain. The actual content and results of the talks shall be subject to the information officially released by both sides, and the predictive content in media reports is for reference only.

segments.src: ## 经贸摩擦：老问题能否有新进展
segments.tr: ## Trade Friction: Can Old Problems Have New Progress?

segments.src: 自双方贸易紧张关系持续以来，关税一直是横亘在两国经济往来中的主要障碍之一。部分行业人士期待，此次高层会晤能够为后续的技术性磋商打开一定空间，但也有观察人士提醒，短期内达成全面性突破的可能性仍然有限。
segments.tr: Since the continued trade tensions between the two sides, tariffs have been one of the main obstacles in economic exchanges between the two countries. Some industry insiders expect that this high-level meeting can open up some space for subsequent technical consultations, but some observers also warn that the possibility of reaching a comprehensive breakthrough in the short term remains limited.

segments.src: 稀土作为新能源、电子制造等多个产业链的关键原材料，其供应稳定性近来也成为国际市场关注的焦点。此次会谈中若能就相关议题释放出积极信号，或将对全球供应链预期产生一定影响。
segments.tr: As a key raw material for many industrial chains such as new energy and electronic manufacturing, the supply stability of rare earths has recently become a focus of international market attention. If positive signals can be released on related topics during this meeting, it may have a certain impact on global supply chain expectations.

segments.src: ## 台海相关议题与人工智能技术限制
segments.tr: ## Taiwan Strait-Related Issues and Artificial Intelligence Technology Restrictions

segments.src: 在地区安全层面，对台军售等相关政策一直是中美之间较为敏感的议题之一。多数分析认为，双方在此类议题上短期内立场很难出现根本性转变，但保持沟通渠道畅通、管控分歧，被普遍视为维护地区稳定的重要基础。
segments.tr: At the level of regional security, policies such as arms sales to Taiwan have always been one of the more sensitive issues between China and the US. Most analyses believe that it is difficult for the two sides to have a fundamental shift in their positions on such issues in the short term, but keeping communication channels open and managing differences is widely regarded as an important foundation for maintaining regional stability.

segments.src: 与此同时，人工智能技术的出口管制与产业竞争,近年来逐渐成为中美博弈的新焦点。有评论指出，随着人工智能技术在军事、经济等领域的应用日益广泛，相关技术限制政策的走向，可能对全球科技产业格局产生深远影响。
segments.tr: At the same time, export controls and industrial competition in artificial intelligence technology have gradually become a new focus of the China-US game in recent years. Some comments point out that as the application of artificial intelligence technology in military, economic, and other fields becomes increasingly widespread, the direction of relevant technology restriction policies may have a profound impact on the global technology industry landscape.
## Subsequent Impact Remains to be Observed

segments.src: 总体来看,此次国事访问被视为观察未来一段时间中美关系走向的重要窗口。无论是经贸议题的阶段性进展，还是地区安全、科技管制等敏感领域的沟通成果，都需要等待双方会后发布的正式声明或联合表态来进一步确认。
segments.tr: Overall, this state visit is seen as an important window to observe the direction of China-US relations in the coming period. Whether it is the phased progress of trade issues or the communication results in sensitive areas such as regional security and technology control, it is necessary to wait for the official statements or joint expressions released by both sides after the meeting to further confirm.

segments.src: 国际社会普遍希望，此次高层互动能够为双边关系注入一定的稳定因素，但多数分析人士也保持谨慎态度，认为结构性分歧的化解仍需长期努力。后续动态值得持续关注。
segments.tr: The international community generally hopes that this high-level interaction can inject certain stable factors into bilateral relations, but most analysts also maintain a cautious attitude, believing that the resolution of structural differences still requires long-term efforts. Subsequent developments are worth continuous attention.

cn-20260923-news-2.title: Middle East situation stirs global shipping landscape: VLCC orders surge this year, Chinese shipyard orders approach 90%

segments.src: ## 地缘局势推高远洋运输需求
segments.tr: ## Geopolitical situation drives up ocean transport demand

segments.src: 进入2026年以来,全球原油贸易格局正在悄然生变。受中东地区局势持续紧张影响,不少石油买家出于供应稳定性的考量,开始调整采购策略,更多地转向距离更远、但被认为相对稳定的原油产地。这种"舍近求远"的采购方式,直接带动了对超大型油轮(VLCC)运力的旺盛需求——毕竟航程越长,单位运力能够完成的运输任务就越少,市场需要更多船只才能填补运力缺口。
segments.tr: Entering 2026, the global crude oil trade pattern is quietly changing. Affected by the continuous tension in the Middle East, many oil buyers, out of consideration for supply stability, have begun to adjust their procurement strategies, turning more to farther but relatively stable crude oil origins. This "far-seeking" procurement method has directly driven the strong demand for Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs) — after all, the longer the voyage, the fewer transportation tasks a unit of capacity can complete, and the market needs more ships to fill the capacity gap.

segments.src: 超大型油轮通常载重20万吨以上,是全球原油海运贸易的主力船型,主要承担中东、西非、南美等产油地与亚洲、欧洲消费市场之间的长距离运输任务。当采购路线从"就近拿货"转向"跨洋采购"时,整个行业对新增运力的胃口也随之被打开。
segments.tr: VLCCs usually have a deadweight of more than 200,000 tons and are the main vessel type for global crude oil maritime trade, mainly undertaking long-distance transportation tasks between oil-producing regions such as the Middle East, West Africa, and South America and consumer markets in Asia and Europe. When procurement routes shift from "nearby sourcing" to "transoceanic procurement", the industry's appetite for new capacity is also opened up.

segments.src: ## 新船订单量创下多年新高
segments.tr: ## New ship order volume hits a multi-year high

segments.src: 行业统计数据显示,今年以来全球超大型油轮新船订单量已经达到217艘,相比之下,2025年全年的订单总量只有93艘。也就是说,不到一年时间里,新增订单数量已经是去年全年水平的两倍以上。这批订单的总价值超过200亿美元,规模之大,在近些年的油轮建造市场上并不多见。
segments.tr: Industry statistics show that since the beginning of this year, the global new ship order volume for VLCCs has reached 217 vessels, compared with a total order volume of only 93 vessels for the whole of 2025. In other words, in less than a year, the number of new orders is more than twice the level of last year as a whole. The total value of this batch of orders exceeds 20 billion US dollars, and such a scale is rare in the tanker construction market in recent years.

segments.src: 业内人士分析认为,订单集中爆发背后有几方面因素叠加:一是船东和石油贸易商对未来几年长航线运输需求的预期明显上调;二是部分老旧船型面临淘汰更新压力,叠加环保排放新规逐步落地,船东有意借此窗口期更新船队;三是充裕的资金环境让不少航运企业有能力在当下加码投资运力,提前锁定未来几年的造船产能和价格。
segments.tr: Industry insiders analyze that behind the concentrated outbreak of orders, several factors are superimposed: first, shipowners and oil traders have significantly upwardly revised their expectations for long-route transportation demand in the next few years; second, some older vessel types face the pressure of retirement and renewal, coupled with the gradual implementation of new environmental protection emission regulations, shipowners intend to use this window period to update their fleets; third, the abundant capital environment enables many shipping companies to increase their investment in capacity at present, locking in shipbuilding capacity and prices for the next few years in advance.

segments.src: ## 中国船厂成为最大赢家
segments.tr: ## Chinese shipyards become the biggest winners

segments.src: 在这一轮订单热潮中,最引人关注的是订单流向。据统计,今年新增的超大型油轮订单里,绝大部分——接近九成——最终落在了中国船厂手中。这一比例远高于以往的行业平均水平,也让中国船厂在全球高端油轮建造市场上的话语权进一步提升。
segments.tr: In this wave of orders, the most eye-catching thing is the flow of orders. According to statistics, among the newly added VLCC orders this year, the vast majority — nearly 90 percent — eventually fell into the hands of Chinese shipyards. This proportion is much higher than the previous industry average, and also further enhances the voice of Chinese shipyards in the global high-end tanker construction market.

segments.src: 中国船厂能够在这轮竞争中占据优势,与多重因素有关。一方面,经过多年技术积累,国内头部船厂在超大型油轮的设计建造工艺、节能环保配置、交付周期控制等方面已经具备较强的综合竞争力;另一方面,相比部分传统造船强国,中国船厂在产能规模和交付排期上更具弹性,能够更好地承接船东集中释放的订单需求。此外,近年来人民币汇率与建造成本的综合优势,也在报价环节为中国船厂加分不少。
segments.tr: The ability of Chinese shipyards to gain an advantage in this competition is related to multiple factors. On the one hand, after years of technological accumulation, domestic leading shipyards have possessed strong comprehensive competitiveness in the design and construction technology of VLCCs, energy-saving and environmental protection configurations, and delivery cycle control; on the other hand, compared with some traditional shipbuilding powers, Chinese shipyards are more flexible in capacity scale and delivery scheduling, and can better undertake the concentrated release of order demand from shipowners. In addition, in recent years, the comprehensive advantages of the RMB exchange rate and construction costs have also added a lot of points to Chinese shipyards in the bidding stage.

segments.src: ## 对行业和市场意味着什么
segments.tr: ## What it means for the industry and the market

segments.src: 对全球航运业而言,这一轮订单潮短期内将直接拉动船厂产能利用率和相关产业链景气度,钢材、船用设备、导航系统等上下游环节都有望受益。中长期来看,如果新增运力如期投入使用,全球超大型油轮的运力结构将出现明显更新,老旧船型占比下降,行业整体能效水平和安全标准有望进一步提升。
segments.tr: For the global shipping industry, this wave of orders will directly boost the capacity utilization rate of shipyards and the prosperity of related industrial chains in the short term, and upstream and downstream links such as steel, marine equipment, and navigation systems are expected to benefit. In the medium and long term, if the new capacity is put into use as scheduled, the capacity structure of global VLCCs will undergo a significant renewal, the proportion of older vessel types will decline, and the overall energy efficiency level and safety standards of the industry are expected to be further improved.

segments.src: 对于普通消费者而言,运输路线和运力的变化最终会传导到能源成本端。分析人士提醒,长航线采购虽然有助于分散供应风险,但也意味着更高的运输成本和更长的到货周期,这些变化未来是否会体现在成品油价格上,仍需持续观察全球原油供需和运价走势。
segments.tr: For ordinary consumers, changes in transportation routes and capacity will eventually be transmitted to the energy cost side. Analysts remind that although long-route procurement helps disperse supply risks, it also means higher transportation costs and longer arrival cycles. Whether these changes will be reflected in refined oil prices in the future still requires continuous observation of global crude oil supply and demand and freight rate trends.

segments.src: 总体来看,这轮超大型油轮订单热潮,既是全球能源贸易格局调整的一个缩影,也再次印证了中国造船业在全球产业链中日益重要的位置。后续船厂交付进度、航运公司运力部署策略,以及国际原油贸易路线的进一步演变,都值得市场持续关注。
segments.tr: Overall, this wave of VLCC order boom is both a microcosm of the adjustment of the global energy trade pattern and once again confirms the increasingly important position of China's shipbuilding industry in the global industrial chain. Subsequent shipyard delivery progress, shipping companies' capacity deployment strategies, and the further evolution of international crude oil trade routes are all worthy of continuous market attention.

cn-20260923-news-3.title: Shanghai Clearing House Adds SGD, NZD, and THB Clearing Services, Further Expanding RMB Cross-Border Settlement Network

segments.src: ## 三种新兴市场货币正式纳入清算范围
segments.tr: ## Three Emerging Market Currencies Officially Included in Clearing Scope

segments.src: 近日，上海清算所宣布新增新加坡元（新元）、新西兰元（纽元）、泰铢三种外汇的清算业务。据披露，业务上线首日相关清算量已接近10亿元人民币，显示出市场机构对新增币种清算服务的实际需求较为旺盛。
segments.tr: Recently, the Shanghai Clearing House announced the addition of clearing services for three foreign currencies: the Singapore Dollar (SGD), the New Zealand Dollar (NZD), and the Thai Baht (THB). According to disclosures, the clearing volume on the first day of operations approached nearly 1 billion RMB, demonstrating robust actual demand from market institutions for the new currency clearing services.

segments.src: 此次扩容后，上海清算所可提供清算服务的外汇币种进一步增加，覆盖范围从传统的美元、欧元、日元等主要货币，延伸至与中国经贸往来密切的东南亚及大洋洲货币，为跨境贸易和投资结算提供了更多本币直接兑换的渠道选择。
segments.tr: Following this expansion, the foreign currency clearing services provided by the Shanghai Clearing House have further increased, extending coverage from traditional major currencies like the USD, EUR, and JPY to Southeast Asian and Oceanian currencies closely tied to China's economic and trade exchanges, providing more channels for direct local currency conversion in cross-border trade and investment settlement.
## Why These Three Currencies Were Chosen

segments.src: 从经贸关联度看，新加坡是中国在东盟地区重要的贸易与投资伙伴，新元在区域金融体系中具有较高的流通度；泰国则是中国—东盟自贸区框架下的重要合作对象，双边贸易与旅游往来频繁，泰铢清算需求持续增长；新西兰与中国在农产品、乳制品等领域贸易往来密切，纽元结算也具备一定的市场基础。
segments.tr: From the perspective of economic and trade correlation, Singapore is an important trade and investment partner for China in the ASEAN region, and the SGD has high liquidity in the regional financial system; Thailand is an important cooperation object under the framework of the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area, with frequent bilateral trade and tourism exchanges, and the demand for THB clearing continues to grow; New Zealand and China have close trade exchanges in agricultural products, dairy products, and other fields, and NZD settlement also has a certain market foundation.

segments.src: 业内人士分析认为，新增清算币种有助于企业在跨境收付时减少经由第三方货币中转带来的汇兑成本和时间损耗，对从事相关区域贸易的外贸企业而言，是结算工具箱的进一步充实。
segments.tr: Industry insiders analyze that the addition of clearing currencies helps enterprises reduce foreign exchange costs and time losses caused by third-party currency transit during cross-border payments and receipts. For foreign trade enterprises engaged in related regional trade, this is a further enrichment of their settlement toolkit.

segments.src: ## 与"一带一路"资金往来的联系
segments.tr: ## Connection to "Belt and Road" Capital Flows

segments.src: 新加坡、泰国均是共建"一带一路"倡议的重要沿线经济体。随着区域产业链合作和基础设施项目推进，跨境资金往来的规模和频次持续提升，市场对多元化、本币化清算基础设施的需求也随之增加。此次上海清算所新增清算服务，被视为跨境金融基础设施建设的又一项常规性完善举措，为相关区域的资金往来提供了更多结算路径选项。
segments.tr: Both Singapore and Thailand are important economies along the "Belt and Road" Initiative. With the advancement of regional industrial chain cooperation and infrastructure projects, the scale and frequency of cross-border capital flows continue to rise, and market demand for diversified, local-currency-based clearing infrastructure has also increased accordingly. The addition of clearing services by the Shanghai Clearing House this time is seen as another routine improvement measure in cross-border financial infrastructure construction, providing more settlement path options for capital flows in related regions.

segments.src: ## 人民币跨境使用版图持续扩大
segments.tr: ## Continued Expansion of the RMB Cross-Border Use Map

segments.src: 近年来，随着人民币跨境支付系统（CIPS）的运行范围不断扩展，以及双边本币互换、直接交易安排的陆续落地，人民币在跨境贸易结算、投资和储备资产中的使用场景逐步增多。上海清算所此次新增币种清算业务，是这一趋势下的具体实践之一，也从侧面反映出境内金融基础设施服务能力的持续提升。
segments.tr: In recent years, with the continuous expansion of the operational scope of the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) and the successive landing of bilateral local currency swaps and direct trading arrangements, the application scenarios of the RMB in cross-border trade settlement, investment, and reserve assets have gradually increased. The addition of currency clearing services by the Shanghai Clearing House this time is one of the specific practices under this trend, and also reflects from the side the continuous enhancement of the service capabilities of domestic financial infrastructure.

segments.src: 需要说明的是，清算业务的扩容属于基础设施层面的服务优化，主要面向银行间市场机构投资者和相关金融机构，普通投资者在日常生活中不会直接接触到这类清算操作。相关货币的汇率仍受多重宏观因素影响，市场参与者在实际业务中应结合自身情况审慎评估，不构成任何形式的投资建议。
segments.tr: It should be noted that the expansion of clearing business belongs to service optimization at the infrastructure level, mainly targeting interbank market institutional investors and related financial institutions. Ordinary investors will not directly contact such clearing operations in their daily lives. The exchange rates of related currencies are still affected by multiple macroeconomic factors, and market participants should prudently evaluate them in actual business based on their own circumstances. This does not constitute any form of investment advice.

segments.src: 市场普遍关注的后续看点包括：新增币种清算量能否保持首日水平的增长势头、是否会有更多参与机构接入相关清算服务，以及未来是否会有其他区域货币被纳入清算范围。总体而言，跨境金融基础设施的渐进式完善，是中国金融市场对外开放进程中的一个持续性环节，其实际效果仍需观察后续数据表现。
segments.tr: Subsequent highlights of general concern to the market include: whether the clearing volume of the new currencies can maintain the growth momentum of the first day, whether more participating institutions will access related clearing services, and whether other regional currencies will be included in the clearing scope in the future. Overall, the progressive improvement of cross-border financial infrastructure is a continuous link in the opening-up process of China's financial market, and its actual effect still needs to be observed through subsequent data performance.
